They are erotic BDSM novels set in a medieval fantasy world, loosely based on the fairy tale of "Sleeping Beauty". [4] «Lewis Mumford | Lewis Mumford, KBE (October 19, 1895 – January 26, 1990) was an American historian, sociologist, philosopher of technology, and literary critic.  Particularly noted for his study of cities and urban architecture, he had a broad career as a writer. The novel was followed by a sequel, "Doctor Sleep", published in 2013.»
